'''Skorokhod''' ({{langx|ru|Скороход}} is a Russian surname derived from the word ''скороход'' meaning ''fast walker''. Notable people with the surname include:

*[[Anatoliy Skorokhod]]
*[[Anna Skorokhod]], Ukrainian politician
